item.title: 🟠 Hackers Poison Adform Script to Swap Crypto Wallet Addresses Across Customer Sites
item.description:
Why this matters: Service impact possible — prepare comms and confirm vendor status.
Attackers modified a JavaScript file served by advertising technology company Adform, turning it into a browser-side tool that rewrites cryptocurrency wallet addresses. item.title: 🟠 Adobe Campaign Classic CVSS 10.0 Flaw Could Run Code Without User Interaction
item.description:
